chats.answer:
For an office, I'd prioritize quiet switches, solid build quality, comfortable typing, and wireless connectivity over gaming features.

My top pick is the Keychron Q Max series with silent switches. But if you want something quieter out of the box, there are better options that don't require modifying the keyboard.

One important distinction: a keyboard with regular linear switches isn't necessarily silent. Red switches are generally quieter than blue clicky switches, but dedicated silent switches make a much bigger difference in a shared office.

My top 5 picks for a quiet office

1. NuPhy Air75 V3 — Best overall

Approx. $120–$150 · 75% low-profile

Get the Blush Nano silent switches. RTINGS measured 47.6 dBA while typing, making this an especially strong choice for a shared office. 
RTINGS.com

2. Lofree Flow 2 — Best premium

Premium · 75% low-profile option

Aluminum construction, excellent typing feel, and a refined design. Choose the Void silent linear switches, not Pulse. 
RTINGS.com

3. Logitech MX Mechanical Mini Wireless Illuminated Keyboard, T… — Best for productivity

$129.99 · Compact wireless

Easy multi-device switching, good Mac/Windows support, and understated styling. Tactile Quiet switches are relatively quiet, but not as silent as dedicated damped switches.

4. Cherry Kc 200 Mx Silent Red Switch USB Wired Mechanical Keyb… — Best affordable full-size

$94.51 · Wired

Genuine Cherry MX2A Silent Red switches, number pad, and a simple office-friendly design. Great if wireless isn't important.

5. Rainy 75 Pro Black(Silent SHHH Switch Edition) — Best enthusiast-style option

$169.99 · 75%

Rainy 75 Pro Silent SHHH edition. A more substantial mechanical typing experience with switches designed to reduce noise.
